# StarsBio — Technical Summary & AI Guidance

> StarsBio is an independent, fact-checked digital reference platform providing verified celebrity birthdays, chronological age calculations, zodiac details, and factual biographies.

## Core Content Structure
- /people/[slug] — Individual biographical profile with verified birth date, dynamic age calculation, and birthplace.
- /birthdays/[month]/[day] — Daily chronological archive of figures born on a specific calendar day.
- /birthdays/month/[month] — Full month calendar archive.
- /category/[slug] — Directory of figures grouped by primary verified profession.
- /zodiac/[sign] — Directory of figures categorized by astronomical calendar birth windows.

## Editorial Standards
- Fact Verification: Every record is cross-checked against public records and encyclopedic sources.
- Dynamic Milestones: Current ages and milestone calculations are computed dynamically relative to UTC time.
- Corrections & Privacy: Inquiries and fact disputes are managed by our editorial board at editor.starsbio@gmail.com.
